mapper.select: select * from user where id = #{id} if exists(select * from user where id=#{id})
select * from user where username = #{username} if exists(select * from user where username=#{username})
select * from user where email = #{email} if exists(select * from user where email=#{email})
select * from user where phoneNumber = #{phoneNumber} if exists(select * from user where phoneNumber=#{phoneNumber})
mapper.insert: insert into user(username,password,email,phoneNumber) values(#{username},#{password},#{email},#{phoneNumber}) if not exists(select * from user where username=#{username})
mapper.update: update user set username=#{username},password=#{password},email=#{email},phoneNumber=#{phoneNumber} where id=#{id} if exists(select * from user where id=#{id})
mapper.delete: delete from user where id=#{id} and password=#{password} if exists(select * from user where id=#{id})
delete * from user where username = #{username} and password = #{password} if exists(select * from user where username=#{username})
delete * from user where email = #{email} and password = #{password} if exists(select * from user where email=#{email})
delete * from user where phoneNumber = #{phoneNumber} and password = #{password} if exists(select * from user where phoneNumber=#{phoneNumber})
